```artifact
Feature: Services and Chemist Operations in Padmavathi Hospital Zone
  Background: When a patient is within the specified radius around Padmavathi Hospital
  
  #1. Patients can register and apply for appointments/consultation requests
    In order to ensure patients can access healthcare services
    Given a patient is within the specified radius around Padmavathi Hospital
    And the patient attempts to register or apply for an appointment/consultation
    When the patient uses the hospital's online service
    Then the system should allow the patient to register or apply successfully
    And the system should provide confirmation of the appointment/consultation request
    And the confirmation should be non-empty (positive)

  #2. Chemists operate 24/7 within each Pincode
    In order to guarantee round-the-clock service for patients
    Given a patient is within the specified radius around Padmavathi Hospital
    And the patient requests a prescription
    When the patient' extrinsic information (Pincode) is used to route the prescription request
    Then the request should be routed to the nearest authorized chemist
    And the system should display the chemist's contact information
    And the contact information should be non-empty (positive)

  #3. Chemists deliver medicines through offline delivery
    In order to provide medication to patients
    Given a patient has received a prescription
    And the chemist has been notified
    When the chemist performs the offline delivery
    Then the medicines should be delivered to the patient's address
    And the delivery should be completed within a reasonable time frame
    And the system should confirm the delivery
    And the confirmation should be non-empty (positive)

  #4. Chemists collect payments from patients
    In order to complete the service transaction
    Given a patient has received medication and the delivery confirmation
    When the patient is expected to make a payment
    Then the payment interface should be accessible
    And the patient should be able to complete the payment process
    And the payment confirmation should be non-empty (positive)

  #5. Chemists mark prescriptions upon completion of delivery
    In order to track medication distribution
    Given a chemist has completed an offline delivery
    And the prescription has been marked as delivered
    When the chemist updates the system status
    Then the system should reflect the marked prescription
    And the system status should indicate completion (positive)

  #6. No systemic matching for chemist efficiency
    In order to maintain privacy and avoid biases
    Given a patient has received medication and the delivery confirmation
    When the system attempts to match chemist efficiency
    Then the system should not perform any matching (negative)

  #7. Availability of Authorized Laboratory per Pincode
    In order to ensure laboratory services are accessible
    Given a patient has received a prescription
    And the patient seeks laboratory services
    When the patient requests laboratory services
    Then the system should direct the patient to the nearest authorized laboratory
    And the system should provide the laboratory's contact information
    And the contact information should be non-empty (positive)

Scenario: Chemist availability and operation
  #8. Chemist operates within a specified Pincode
    In order to ensure chemists are within reach for patients
    Given a patient with a specific Pincode within the specified radius
    And the patient requests a prescription
    When the patient's Pincode is used to route the prescription request
    Then the system should route the request to the correct chemist
    And the system should confirm the chemist's availability
    And the confirmation should be non-empty (positive)

  #9. Chemist delivers medicines and collects payment
    In order to complete the service transaction
    Given a patient has received medication and the delivery confirmation
    When the patient makes a payment
    Then the payment interface should be accessible
    And the patient should be able to complete the payment process
    And the payment confirmation should be non-empty (positive)

Scenario: Chemist marking prescriptions
  #10. Chemist marks prescriptions upon delivery completion
    In order to track medication distribution
    Given a chemist has completed an offline delivery
    When the chemist marks the prescription as delivered
    Then the system should reflect the marked prescription
    And the system should indicate completion (positive)

Scenario: Laboratory services
  #11. Laboratory services for patients
    In order to ensure patients receive necessary tests
    Given a patient has received a prescription
    And the patient seeks laboratory services
    When the patient requests laboratory services
    Then the system should direct the patient to the nearest authorized laboratory
    And the system should provide the laboratory's contact information
    And the contact information should be non-empty (positive)

Scenario: No systemic matching of chemist efficiency
  #12. No systemic matching for chemist efficiency
    In order to maintain privacy and avoid biases
    Given a patient has received medication and the delivery confirmation
    When the system attempts to match chemist efficiency
    Then the system should not perform any matching (negative)

Scenario: Chemist and laboratory availability
  #13. Chemist and laboratory availability within Pincode
    In order to ensure both chemists and laboratories are within reach for patients
    Given a patient with a specific Pincode within the specified radius
    And the patient seeks both chemist and laboratory services
    When the patient requests both services
    Then the system should direct the patient to the nearest chemist and laboratory
    And the system should provide the respective contact information
    And both contact information should be non-empty (positive)

Scenario: Non-empty confirmations
  #14. Non-empty confirmations for all services
    In order to ensure patients receive confirmation for all interactions
    Given a patient has interacted with the system for registration, prescription, delivery, and payment
    When the patient completes all interactions
    Then all system confirmations should be non-empty (positive)

# Boundary and Error Paths
  #15. Boundary: Chemist at the edge of service area
    In order to test the system's response at the edge of service area
    Given a patient is at the boundary of the specified radius around Padmavathi Hospital
    And the patient requests a prescription
    When the patient's Pincode is used to route the prescription request
    Then the system should handle the request appropriately, possibly indicating limited chemist availability

  #16. Error: Invalid Pincode
    In order to test the system's response to incorrect Pincode input
    Given a patient enters an invalid Pincode
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should reject the request with an appropriate error message

  #17. Error: No confirmation after service
    In order to test the system's error handling
    Given a patient has interacted with the system for registration, prescription, delivery, and payment
    When the patient expects to receive a non-empty confirmation after each interaction
    Then the system should provide a non-empty confirmation for each successful interaction

# Oracle Assertiveness
  #18. Confirmation of successful registration
    The system should provide a non-empty confirmation after successful registration
  #19. Confirmation of successful appointment/consultation request
    The system should provide a non-empty confirmation after a successful appointment/consultation request
  #20. Confirmation of successful delivery
    The system should provide a non-empty confirmation after successful delivery
  #21. Confirmation of successful payment
    The system should provide a non-empty confirmation after successful payment
  #22. Confirmation of prescription marking
    The system should provide a non-empty confirmation after the prescription is marked as delivered
  #23. Systemic matching rejection
    The system should not provide any confirmation related to chemist efficiency matching

# Groundedness
  All concrete values such as time frames, contact information, and error messages should be derived from the requirement text.
```
